::: {.modules-landing-panel role="note" aria-label="Track summary"}
<strong>12 modules</strong>
<span>4 learning phases</span>
<span>Reproducible R scripts</span>
<span>Local completion and certificate</span>
:::
:::

::: {.phase-grid role="list" aria-label="Learning phases"}
::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**01 · Foundations**

Modules 01-02: breeding logic, phenotype decomposition, response to selection.
:::

::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**02 · Data and parameters**

Modules 03-06: descriptive statistics, variance components, heritability and correlations.
:::

::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**03 · Modeling**

Modules 07-09: linear/mixed models, BLUP, pedigree and relationship structures.
:::

::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**04 · Genomics**

Modules 10-12: SNP markers, QC, genomic matrices, GWAS and prediction.
:::
:::
